claims.sourceText: Tom Mahood, 'The Robert Lazar Timeline', https://otherhand.org/home-page/area-51-and-other-strange-places/bluefire-main/bluefire/the-bob-lazar-corner/the-lazar-timeline/ , opened 2026-09-18
claims.text: Tom Mahood's timeline records that Knapp began interviewing Lazar in March 1989, that the silhouetted interviews under the pseudonym 'Dennis' aired in May 1989, that KLAS-TV identified and interviewed him publicly on 10 November 1989, and that Lazar appeared on Knapp's KLAS programme 'On The Record' on 9 December 1989. No 1989-dated artefact was opened by this session and these dates are carried at Tier 3.

claims.sourceText: Tom Mahood, 'The Robert Lazar Timeline', https://otherhand.org/home-page/area-51-and-other-strange-places/bluefire-main/bluefire/the-bob-lazar-corner/the-lazar-timeline/ , opened 2026-09-18
claims.text: Lear and Lazar had met by 1988. Lear was present at the first and third of the three Wednesday-night desert viewings, on 22 March 1989 and 5 April 1989, and Mahood's timeline records that at the first of those 'only Lear saw the elliptical shape through a telescope'. On 5 April 1989 the group, including Lear, was detained by the Lincoln County Sheriff after guards discovered them.

claims.sourceText: Tom Mahood, 'The Robert Lazar Timeline', https://otherhand.org/home-page/area-51-and-other-strange-places/bluefire-main/bluefire/the-bob-lazar-corner/the-lazar-timeline/ , opened 2026-09-18
claims.text: Two further dated 1989 appearances are recorded by the same timeline and are useful chiefly as artefacts a later session could try to open: 'Billy Goodman Happening' radio with Lazar and Gene Huff on 21 November 1989, and the same programme again on 20 December 1989.

claims.sourceText: Tom Mahood, 'The Robert Lazar Timeline', https://otherhand.org/home-page/area-51-and-other-strange-places/bluefire-main/bluefire/the-bob-lazar-corner/the-lazar-timeline/ , opened 2026-09-18
claims.text: THE AIR DATES ARE TIER 3 AND MUST STAY THERE UNTIL AN ARTEFACT IS OPENED. Tom Mahood's timeline records that George Knapp began interviewing Lazar in March 1989 'for safekeeping purposes'; that in May 1989 'his silhouetted interviews with Knapp aired on KLAS-TV using the pseudonym Dennis'; that on 10 November 1989 'KLAS-TV identified and interviewed RL publicly'; and that on 9 December 1989 Lazar appeared on 'On The Record', hosted by Knapp on KLAS-TV. Some accounts give 11 November rather than 10 November for the named interview. No 1989-dated artefact was opened by this board.

edges.label: Met by 1988; present at two of the three 1989 desert viewings
edges.note: THIS EDGE DOES NOT SAY LEAR INTRODUCED LAZAR TO KNAPP. That is universally repeated and it is in nothing this board opened.

edges.label: Carrier of the claim, not an eyewitness to the claimed site
edges.note: CARRIER, NOT EYEWITNESS TO THE SITE. Lear promoted the account and was present at two of the three 1989 desert viewings, on 22 March and 5 April. No opened record has him claiming to have seen the facility itself. Tier 3 accordingly.

edges.label: The original broadcast artefact of the claim
edges.note: Tier 3 on this board for one reason only: NOT ONE OF THESE BROADCASTS WAS OPENED. The dates on this edge are from a secondary chronology and should be replaced when an artefact is reached.
